text: Every image is the same Gradle-built jar on the plain JRE, as a user without root rights; the limits and JVM options come from the cluster.

text: A rolling update starts a new pod before it stops an old one, and a short pause before shutdown lets the Service stop sending requests first.

text: The app then finishes what it is doing, for up to sixty seconds, longer than the slowest scheme call.
